significance: At a = 6, all nine slices of the fundamental box admit partitions into six-point saturated chains. The 1,296 ribbons cover all 7,776 points.
prior_work: Armstrong reports constructions at a = 3 and 4 and computational confirmation at a = 5. His standard partitions through a = 20 impose a weaker condition. Germ positivity computations do not construct saturated chains. The literature review located no prior a = 6 ribbon partition; priority remains undetermined.
